name: Teen Volunteering at Denver Public Library
what_you_do: Teens 14 and up can apply to volunteer at the library.
who_can_apply: Teens must be 14 or older to apply.
deadline_text: The page says all current teen volunteer positions are filled. No reopening date is posted.
how_to_apply: Look at the page to see what is open. If you have questions, email volunteers@denverlibrary.org.
notes: The main volunteer page says most roles are for adults 18 and older, but teen roles exist. Positions fill up, so email the volunteer office to ask when more open.
